theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_hsif_contDiffOn_clm_iff_columns
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (m : ℕ) (g : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] E)) (U : Set (Rn n)), ContDiffOn ℝ m g U ↔ ∀ k : Fin n, ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun x => g x (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ))) U
